definitions.explanation: A classical compound referring to flowers and birds as representative of the beauty of nature. A major theme in traditional East Asian art and poetry.

examples.japanese: {花鳥|かちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧。
examples.english: A hanging scroll depicting flowers and birds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花鳥風月|かちょうふうげつ}→花鳥風月：21565_kachoufuugetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{愛|あい}でる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧だ。
examples.english: Appreciating the beauties of nature is a Japanese tradition.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{花鳥画|かちょうが}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られ→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{繊細|せんさい}→繊細：07607_sensai⟧な{筆使|ふでづか}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: This painter was known for flower-and-bird paintings and left many masterpieces with delicate brushwork.

notes:
A classical literary compound representing the beauty of nature through its two most celebrated elements — flowers and birds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{花鳥風月|かちょうふうげつ}→花鳥風月：21565_kachoufuugetsu⟧ (the beauties of nature — flowers, birds, wind, and moon)
- {花鳥画|かちょうが} (flower-and-bird painting)
- {花鳥|かちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{愛|め}でる→愛でる：12627_mederu⟧ (appreciate flowers and birds)

⟦{花鳥風月|かちょうふうげつ}→花鳥風月：21565_kachoufuugetsu⟧ is a well-known four-character compound (yojijukugo) meaning the beauties of nature or the elegant appreciation of natural scenery. It is used to describe a refined aesthetic sensibility. {花鳥画|かちょうが} is a major genre in East Asian painting.

Note the homophone ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧ (section chief), which is completely different.
